subject: Re: Minimum spend options + surge cushion and ad-hoc overage rates
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acadiahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Acadia Health Procurement <procurement@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Minimum spend + on-demand overage for bursts

Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We have a few open items from our procurement side while we finalize the SOW: primarily around minimum monthly spend and how you handle ad-hoc "burst" usage above any committed tier.

Can you send a simple breakdown showing: 1) minimum monthly spend options (12/24 month commit tiers), 2) how you price on-demand overage (per token) when a customer exceeds commit in a given month, and 3) any "surge" or grace cushion you offer (temporary burst allowances).

I've attached the RFP Qs folks asked for — should help frame their ask.

--
Tom Reynolds
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Acadia Health
procurement@acadiahealth.com
Attachment: Acadia_RFP_Qs.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Acadia Health Procurement <procurement@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Minimum spend + on-demand overage for bursts

Tom — thanks, and appreciate the clear ask. High-level options below (happy to join procurement call to walk through):

Option A — Predictable commit (recommended for steady workloads)
- 12-month commit: minimum $75k/month committed spend (billed monthly)
- Committed unit price: $8 per 1M tokens
- Surge cushion: first 20% of monthly commit can be absorbed (no overage charge)
- Beyond 20%: on-demand overage = $14 per 1M tokens
- True-up: quarterly true-up and annual reconciliation

Option B — Flexible commit + ad-hoc (recommended if you expect uneven seasonality)
- Minimum: $35k/month committed, 12-month term
- Committed unit price: $9.50 per 1M tokens
- Surge bracketed billing: 0-20% of commit free; 20-100% billed at 1.6x committed price ($15.2 per 1M); >100% billed at 2.0x committed price ($19 per 1M)
- 30-day true-up window; month-to-month billing beyond initial term

Option C — No commit (on-demand)
- No minimum; list price $22 per 1M tokens (pay-as-you-go)

Notes:
- We can tailor the free cushion or the breakpoints for the surge brackets for enterprise customers; smaller pilots typically choose Option B.
- If you want an SLA-backed latency target tied to commit, that's available under dedicated terms (separate contract).

I've attached a short proposal (Redwood-proposal-2026-11-27.pdf) with the above sketched into contract language and a sample MUT. If it helps, I can schedule a procurement sync Thursday.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-proposal-2026-11-27.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Minimum spend + on-demand overage for bursts

Hannah — quick internal note after looking at these rates. Option A margins look okay, but Option B overage bands (1.6x / 2.0x) may erode if we provide large free cushions or if their usage is highly spiky month-to-month. Two suggestions:

1) Introduce a hard cap per-burst instance (e.g., per 24h burst cap) to protect against a single-day spike from eating margin.
2) Consider tiered overage floors for first 5M tokens of overage (slightly higher rate) to discourage microbursts that are expensive operationally.

Happy to join call with procurement if you want to align on negotiation levers.

—Ben

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Minimum spend + on-demand overage for bursts (internal)

Thanks — good points. Proposed compromise to present to Acadia:
- Keep Option B as the baseline for their pilot, but modify brackets as follows:
  * 0-25% of commit free (slightly larger cushion)
  * 25-100% billed at 1.75x committed price
  * >100% billed at 2.25x committed price
- Add a per-burst 24-hour cap at 15M tokens billed at the >100% rate to limit blowouts
- Implement a 30-day rolling true-up with a soft monthly notification at 70% usage to avoid surprises

If Acadia pushes back on the per-burst cap, we can instead move to a stepped first-overage floor for the first 5M tokens at 2.5x. I'll propose this on the call and note that these are pilot-friendly concessions — keep our margin protected.

Hannah

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acadiahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acadia Health Procurement <procurement@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Minimum spend + on-demand overage for bursts

Hannah — thanks for the fast turnaround. The team reviewed the proposal and we are willing to move forward with a 6-month pilot on the flexible commit (Option B) with the surge-bracket modifications you outlined in the internal note (0-25% free; 25-100% at 1.75x; >100% at 2.25x) plus the 24-hour 15M token cap.

Two asks before we sign: 1) insert explicit language in the SOW about a 30-day true-up and notification windows at 60/80/100% thresholds, and 2) include a 30-day termination clause after the pilot for our legal team to clear.

If you can send an updated SOW and signature page this week we can get procurement started. Looking forward to the pilot.

--
Tom Reynolds
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Acadia Health
procurement@acadiahealth.com
